Reviewer B claims: Severity: Low

Reviewer B claims: Severity: Medium
Reviewer B claims: Files/Lines:
Reviewer B claims: All test YAML files updating image versions

Reviewer B claims: Description: Changing test image versions across multiple test fixtures could potentially impact test reliability. The changes appear to be a bulk update rather than targeted fixes.

Reviewer B claims: Test Stability**: The bulk update of multiple test image versions could introduce subtle behavioral changes that may affect test reliability. The changes should be verified with test runs.

Reviewer B claims: Security Implications**: There's no mention of whether these version updates include security patches. The maintainers should verify if any of these updates address known vulnerabilities.
Reviewer B claims: Maintenance Overhead**: Having so many different test images with independent versioning increases maintenance complexity. Consider if some of these could be consolidated.
Reviewer B claims: Add a changelog reference or justification comment explaining why each image version is being updated.
Reviewer B claims: Consider grouping related image updates into separate commits/PRs for better traceability.
Reviewer B claims: Verify test stability after these changes through comprehensive test runs.
Reviewer B claims: Document the version update policy for test images to guide future updates.
